meta.method: RI statewide peer normalisation (z-score for bars, mid-rank percentile for ring)
meta.peer_set: all RI municipalities with a non-null feature value
meta.caveat: Statuses are relative to RI peers, not absolute. Proxied/null metrics are flagged per metric.

normalization.z: z = (x - mean)/sd over the 39 RI municipalities with a non-null value (population sd; sd=0 -> 0)
normalization.pct: pct = 100*(n_less + 0.5*n_equal)/n over the same peer set
normalization.ring: ring = sum(w*p)/sum(w over available), p = pct if s=+1 else 100-pct
normalization.confidence: confidence = (sum(w available)/sum(w all)) * proxy_cap; metric null if coverage < 0.50

overall.meaning: green=growth, yellow=stagnation, red=decline; PEER-RELATIVE to RI

recent_housing_share.formula: share of housing built 2000+ (PROXY for recent permits; permits data not in hand)

production_transport_occ.formula: share of workers in production/transport occupations

premium_ratio.formula: ln( mgmt/professional worker share / detached single-family share of units )

worker_ratio.formula: ln( (service+sales/office+blue-collar worker share) / (attached,2-9 unit,mobile-home share of units) )

underemployed_over_older_ratio.formula: ln( mean(unemployment rate, poverty rate) / share of housing built before 1960 )

prof_job_ratio.formula: ln( professional-sector establishment share (NAICS 51,52,54,55,61,62) / resident mgmt-professional worker share )

labor_job_ratio.formula: ln( labor-sector establishment share (NAICS 23,31-33,42,44-45,48-49,56,72,81) / resident labor worker share )

industrial_est_density.formula: NAICS 31-33,42,48-49 establishments per sq mi land

commute_minutes_density.formula: aggregate commute minutes per sq mi land (vehicle-activity proxy)

employment_density.formula: CBP jobs per sq mi land

business_new_enterprise.label: New enterprise
business_new_enterprise.notes: Recent building permits are not in hand; share of housing built 2000+ is used as a labeled growth proxy (20% weight).

housing_underemployed.label: Underemployed housing
housing_underemployed.notes: Surplus = unmet low-rent housing need (stress). Older (pre-1960) stock is the low-rent supply proxy.

labor_managerial.label: Managerial-professional
labor_managerial.notes: Jobs approximated by establishment share, not job counts.

education.label: Education quality
education.notes: Regional districts mapped to member towns via the documented crosswalk.

health.null_reason: No health outcome data in hand (CDC PLACES / RI DOH not retrieved). Not proxied: no honest free proxy among held inputs.

pollution.label: Pollution
pollution.notes: PROXY: no emissions/air-quality data held. Industrial establishment density + commute-minute density.

traffic.label: Traffic
traffic.notes: PROXY: no traffic counts held. Commute time + residential and job density.

land_value.label: Land value
land_value.notes: PROXY: assessed land values not held; ACS home value and rent used.

city_cash_flow.label: City cash flow
city_cash_flow.notes: PROXY (revenue side only): municipal expenditures/budgets are stubbed, so net cash flow cannot be computed.
